chunks.text: Been thinking about doing a quick little trip to Xi'an sometime soon, mostly just to wander around and see a couple of the main sights.
If I actually make it happen, I keep coming back to the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda as the one attraction I’d want to prioritize.
In my head it’d be like May 12, 2026, probably an afternoon slot, and it’d be under the name Xie Peng.
Oh and totally separately, I’ve also been considering a Wuhan stop later on, and I’d probably want to stay somewhere decent there.

If that Wuhan thing happens, I might end up at Wanda Realm Wuhan, checking in on 2026-05-24 for 2 nights, guest name Hu Bin… and for the Xi'an pagoda idea it’d be 5 tickets. Not sure if I’ll actually do this.
